digest.component_or_area: plan-review and code-review documentation and CLI
propositions: Authors struggle to discover how to write plans that pass the plan-review gate because existing material is either gate-mechanics or a reviewer-facing criterion registry
The code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified) lacks discoverable author-facing documentation equivalent to the plan-review on-ramp
AGENTS.md incorrectly points authors at the criterion registry for the description template instead of author-facing guidance
The rebar explain CLI seam needs to be extended to route author-guide names (plan, review) in addition to criterion IDs through the shared registry lookup
New prose on-ramp docs must remain distinct from the generated criterion registry to preserve it as the single source of truth for reviewers
The docs-index CI gate requires all top-level docs/*.md files to be linked from docs/README.md
